dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Welcome to Bertin's House of Curiosities.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: I apologize, but I haven't encountered anything that catches my fancy lately. Come again later, if you please.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're a collector?

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Not exactly. I'm actually a clothes designer.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: If you ask someone in Fontaine about tailoring recommendations, there's a good chance that you'd either hear my name...

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: ...Or that of "Chiori"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll pass for now.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Sure. Come again next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chiori?

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: I refer to Chioriya Boutique's Chiori, a designer from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Her tastes... aren't bad, but we've got differences in ideas. She's also a rather picky character — even her works do not satisfy her.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: The last time I spoke to her of a design flaw in her work, not only did she not get angry, but she even picked at her own work more vehemently than I. I didn't dare put a word in lengthwise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Please, take your pick. I do hope something catches your eye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need something that will spark some inspiration...

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that depends on how much value the customer places on the collectible. I hope you find it useful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is collecting a hobby of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Yes, it's also a way of seeking design inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: I believe that "only those that are completely forgotten can become something that is brand-new."

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Fashion is a loop of becoming outdated and then coming back in trend. If you're interested, take this. It's no longer useful to me anyway.
